The '''hellhounds''' are [[monster]]s involved in the Hellhound Pack event in [[Wilderness Flash Events]].

During the event, they spawn near the [[Ladder (Death Plateau/Wilderness)|ladder]] to the [[All Fired Up (minigame)|east of Death Plateau beacon]] in [[Trollheim]], just south of the [[green dragon]]s. Players taking part must deal at least 70K damage to obtain a reward, while the players collectively must kill a varying number of them, depending on the number of players in the area. The event end in five minutes or once the collective target has been met, whichever happens first. Successful completion of the event yields a [[Combat XP lamp (Wilderness Flash Events)|combat XP lamp]] and a [[sack of wild rewards]].

Unlike their naturally occurring counterparts, they are not vulnerable to certain weaponry such as [[Darklight]] or [[Holy water]].

Their [[life points]] scale with the number of players in the area. The possible values are 10,250<!-- N = 1, 22 group target -->, 12,500<!-- N = 2 -->, 19,250, 28,000, 28,250<!--38 group target-->, 30,000, 30,500<!--40 group target-->, 46,250<!--54 group target--> and 48,500<!--56 group target-->. The life points scale with the number of players participating in the event, determined by the expression <math>8\,000 + 2\,250N</math>, where <math>N</math> is the number of players involved.
